activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Nothing has happened on this case yet.

decision.title: Decide the request
decision.subtitle: This is step 4 of the process. The decision cannot be undone from here.
decision.reasonPlaceholder: What should the recipient do next?
decision.recorded: Decision recorded — the case is now {{status}}.
decision.approveWarning: Approving commits the request and brings the financing into existence. The case continues as the financing from here.
decision.sendBackWarning: This sends the case out of your hands. Whoever picks it up will act on the reason you give.

committed.label: Approve
committed.description: Commit the request. The financing comes into existence.

rejected.label: Reject
rejected.description: Refuse the request. It does not become a financing.

missing_information.label: Information missing
missing_information.description: Ask the leasing company for something before deciding.

rework.label: Internal rework
rework.description: Send the case back inside the bank to be corrected.

detail.loadError: This case could not be loaded. Please try again.
detail.uploadBlockedUnclaimed: This case has not been taken over yet. Take it over before uploading documents.

list.title: Cases
list.subtitle: Every case that moves a set of lease contracts through refinancing.

emptyState.title: No cases yet
emptyState.description: Cases appear here as they are created.

emptyFiltered.title: No cases match this filter
emptyFiltered.description: Try a different filter to see more cases.

start.title: Start a case
start.subtitle: Pick the case type. The reference is assigned automatically, and you go straight to the case's documents.

state.title: State
state.explanation: The status shown is derived from the case, the request and the financing together. The case status is the case's own stored state — filters and sorting run on the stored sets, never on the derived value.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this case?
cancelConfirm.description: Cancelling ends the case. It can be reactivated afterwards, but any work in progress stops here.

actions.submitted: The refinancing request has been submitted.

bulk.title: Bulk file validation
bulk.subtitle: Each record is matched against the contract registry before anything is created.
bulk.uploadHint: CSV or Excel. Nothing is added to the case until you confirm the result.
bulk.alreadyCommitted: This file has already been added ({{count}} contract).
bulk.alreadyCommitted_other: This file has already been added ({{count}} contracts).

company.searchPlaceholder: Type at least 3 characters of the company name
company.noMatches: No leasing company matches that name.

noLcNumber.title: This company has no dealer number
noLcNumber.description: {{name}} cannot be bound to a case: the platform identifies a leasing company on a case by its dealer number, and none is recorded. Add one on the partner record first.

noAgreement.title: No active framework agreement
noAgreement.description: This leasing company has no active framework agreement, so no product template can be picked and the request cannot proceed.

multipleAgreements.title: More than one active agreement
multipleAgreements.description: {{count}} active framework agreements were found for this company, but a company should have exactly one. The templates below come from the first; check the agreements before continuing.

company.templateHelper: Only templates the framework agreement allows can be picked.
company.noTemplates: The framework agreement allows no product templates

cashFlow.noContract: Add contract details or an object first — a payment plan belongs to a saved contract.

none.title: No payment plan yet
none.description: This contract has no financing component, so no plan exists. Generate one from the contract's terms, or enter the schedule by hand.

cashFlow.invalidRows: Check line {{rows}} — each line needs a date and an amount with at most two decimals.
cashFlow.finalRule: Exactly one line must be marked as the final payment.

errors.termFormat: Enter the term in whole months.

object.heading: Lease objects ({{count}})
object.empty: No objects on this contract yet.

fields.subGroupHelp: For a vehicle group this is the fuel type. One field, not two — “fuel type” is only its report name in the vehicle case.

parties.guarantorEmpty: No guarantors or co-obligors on this contract.
parties.searchPlaceholder: Type at least 3 characters of the partner name
parties.noMatches: No confirmed partner matches that name.

createAbsent.title: A party not yet in the registry cannot be added here
createAbsent.description: Only confirmed partners from the bank's registry can be linked. Creating a partner in place is a separate form covering three partner types, and it is not built yet — if the lessee or a guarantor is missing, create them in Partner management first.

plan.title: Payment plan
plan.note: The platform reproduces the lease; it does not re-price it.

summaryCards.name: Name
summaryCards.figuresPartial: Lessee count, start dates and average term are hidden: only {{shown}} of {{total}} contracts were loaded, so those figures cannot be computed for the whole request.

objectsAbsent.title: Number of objects is not shown
objectsAbsent.description: The platform has no object count for a request before it is approved, so this figure cannot be included in the summary. It becomes available on the financing.

notBuilt.title: Not built yet
notBuilt.description: This area has a design but no implementation on this screen yet.

generated.title: Generated documents
generated.subtitle: Created directly from the case data. Everything else on this tab is uploaded.

handover.title: OS+ transfer file
handover.subtitle: CSV export for loan setup in OS+.

combined.title: Merge documents
combined.subtitle: Combines all generated and uploaded documents into a PDF with a table of contents.

collateral.title: Collateral (DAT data)
collateral.invalidTotal: The value must be an amount with at most two decimal places.

absent.title: No collateral recorded
absent.description: Nothing has been determined for this case yet. Every figure here is obtained outside the platform.

blocking.title: Approval is blocked
blocking.needsRedetermine: The package composition changed, so the collateral figure must be determined again before the case can be approved.
blocking.needsConfirm: A new figure has been determined and now needs confirming by someone else before the case can be approved.

redetermine.label: Re-determine the value
redetermine.help: Enter the newly determined figure. The re-check does not clear by acknowledgement — a fresh value is required.
redetermine.done: New collateral value recorded. It now needs confirming by someone else.

confirm.help: You are confirming the re-determined figure. This is the second pair of eyes.
confirm.notYou: You determined this figure, so someone else must confirm it.
